title: Organize pages and Combine Files UI
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-13, A-14, A-26 and A-29 work on real documents in all four theme/control combinations
notes: App half of the organise pair per ADR 0012. Serves acceptance items A-13 (Pages panel with real count, grid toggle, insert page), A-14 (thumbnails with multi-select and drag reorder), A-26 (Organize Pages: reorder, rotate, delete, insert, extract, split) and A-29 (Combine Files: merge several PDFs, and images, into one) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Drives the core page plans through the pdfxi-document session of ADR 0010 and never re-implements page-tree edits in the shell. Grid view with multi-select, drag reorder, rotate, delete, insert blank or from file, extract, split, and combine PDFs and images. Calls the library and does not change its semantics; feature-matrix rows stay as the library left them until this task verifies them.
